inventory_rationale: Every accepted State 5 public operation is one public function of its owning module. Internal functions are declared only where a module's hidden mechanism has a stable seam another of its functions reuses: the monotonic deadline object of clock, the continuation-token codec of store, the configuration read shared by start and re-read, the corpus read, trial execution and admission of functions, the manifest record reading of bindings, the proof of flows, authority and the two store calls around a send in effects, the executor, function element and run answer of runs, and in surface the start sequence, request handling, token comparison, masking and one handler per MCP operation of the State 5 catalogue. The kernel has no HTTP API of its own (K-11), so no operation is externally exposed through the HTTP router and no router handler is planned.

functions.purpose: Encode one value as RFC 8785 canonical JSON bytes, or refuse a value JCS cannot represent.
Compute the SHA-256 identity of a content record or value from its canonical form, order-free lists sorted.
Judge one value against one port — presence, carriage, schema, size, many — and name the first failure.
Return the highest disclosure class of a set, open when empty.
Return the one kernel timestamp source.
Return a monotonic deadline for a bounded wait.
Take the exclusive lock, check the data directory and remove temporary files before any record is read.
Page one record type in reverse store order under a caller filter, refusing a token that names no position.
Publish value bytes or a file fixture complete and digest-checked into the content-addressed area, equal bytes once.
Read records a caller names, by identity or by owner-defined relation.
Return the bytes a StoredValue or SpooledFile names; whether a run still holds its spool is checked by its caller.
Apply one named change of the closed set in one transaction, wholly or not at all.
Remove the spool of a run the caller names.
Publish a file into its run's spool with digest and size, within the spool ceilings.
Return the current token list, re-read when the file changed, or none after a failed re-read.
Load and check the configuration file at start.
Return the manifest location and revision fixed at start.
Resolve one service's credential header and value only while a request is built.
Return the manifest instance the installation selects for a service, or none.
Execute one implementation on one input set in a fresh isolated environment and name how it ended.
Check at start that bubblewrap is present and one probe execution succeeds.
Judge whether a binding's ports fit the request shape of its method and path.
Build one request from a ManifestOperation and inputs, with its description and request_digest, or name the first pre-send failure.
Send one prepared request once and name its outcome by the A09 table.
Add a case captured from a checked failed execution to its contract version's corpus.
Add an authored trial case that fits its contract version.
Return a contract version's current activation, or none.
Issue a contract version within the release ceilings, creating its slot when new.
Return one contract version's ports and bounds.
Return one implementation's code and its contract version's bounds.
Return a slot's contract versions, implementations, verdicts and current activation.
Activate an earlier implementation admitted over the current corpus.
Accept an implementation, admit it over the whole corpus and activate it when admitted.
Execute an existing implementation on named cases and return trial evidence, no verdict.
Accept a proposed binding after re-reading its manifest entry.
Before a send, return the current ManifestOperation with instance facts, or binding_stale.
At start, refuse a credential header that names a required header or a kernel-set header.
Check a proposal against the manifest and record it proposed with its pinned digest.
Return one binding: status, effect class, key fields, declared classes, ports.
Prove a flow version again and activate it by the kernel or the owner.
Return a flow's active version and its activation, or none.
Keep a flow version after its pre-proof refusals.
Return a flow version's proof: proven with its highest effect class, or the first failure.
Return one flow version's graph.
Record the owner's approval or refusal of a requested approval.
Grant a standing approval for a non-destructive node of a flow's active version.
Return an operation element's conclusion from its records.
Reach one operation element: pre-send checks, authority, in-flight record, send, outcome record.
At start, turn every in_flight attempt unknown with its record.
Record the owner's resolution of an unknown attempt.
Revoke an active standing approval.
End a run cancelled at the owner's request.
Check a failed execution and its run, copy its inputs, and hand the case to functions.
Apply the owner's approval decision and advance the run.
Apply the owner's resolution and advance the run.
Return a run's answer computed from its trace.
At start, remove spools of ended runs that keep none and advance runs left running.
Release a failed run's spool.
Resend elements waiting on an unreachable service and advance the run.
Start and pin a run of a flow's active version and advance it.
Start the kernel in its fixed order and serve the one MCP entrance.
Hold one monotonic deadline as a reading of the host monotonic clock plus a duration; it is never stored.
Answer whether the host monotonic clock has reached the deadline.
Return the whole milliseconds left before the deadline, zero once it has passed.
Encode the store position of the last item returned together with the record type and canonical filter it was issued for.
Return the store position a token names, refusing a malformed token or one issued for another record type or filter.
Read and check the configuration file once: a regular private file of the kernel's user, tokens long enough and pairwise distinct.
Return a contract version's corpus in corpus order through store.read_records.
Execute one implementation on one trial case in the sandbox, judge pass or output_mismatch, and record the TrialExecution.
As the kernel actor, run admission over the whole current corpus in corpus order without stopping early, or reuse the verdict for an unchanged corpus, and activate what it admits.
Read one service record at the configured manifest location and revision and refuse a record that fails a check of the record itself.
Read one operation of a service record with the instance facts the installation selects, refusing the first failing check of the record itself.
Run the nine proof phases over one flow version in their fixed order and return the first failure or proven with its highest effect class.
Find the authority A10 rule 1 gives the send as it stands now, or none.
Write the in-flight attempt when the class is not read, send once, and write the outcome record in one store call.
Advance one run one node at a time inside the current request until nothing can execute, and write its status and waiting points.
Execute one function element of a run in the sandbox and build its NodeExecution, output values and spooled files.
Compute a run's answer from its record and trace: status, outputs produced, waiting points with approval ids, missing-output reasons once ended.
Run every start step in its fixed order and stop at the first that fails.
Handle one MCP request to its end in A16 rule 1 order and return the answer bytes, never a secret, path or stack trace.
Compare a presented token in constant time with the current token list and return its actor, or none.
Turn a module's refusal into its State 5 code and bounded reason; every other failure, a stop included, into internal_error without detail.
Resolve the values and files of record ports for one reader, a personal_data item to an agent as digest and class only.
